full_judgment: 3. The plaintiff-opposite parties who were not parties in the previous Title Suit No. 59 of 1992 instituted the present suit being Title Suit No. 102 of 1995 under section 9 of the Specific Relief Act in the Second Court of Subordinate Judge, Dhaka for recovery of khas possession on the said suit property. The suit was, thereafter, transferred to the court of additional sub-ordinate Judge, Dhaka and re-numbered there as Title Suit No. 9 of 1996. The learned additional sub-ordinate Judge, Dhaka decreed the suit in favour of the plaintiff-opposite-parties and directed the present defendant-petitioners to hand over the possession of the suit property in favour of the plaintiff-opposite-parties.
